heard: The first probe orbiting Mars found it swallowed by dust. Mariner 9 beat its twin, which crashed in the ocean. A planet-wide storm had blinded the entire Red Planet. Two Soviet probes arrived and blindly took photos of dust. Their fixed programming could not adapt to the storm. NASA engineers reprogrammed Mariner 9 from Earth to weight. When dust cleared, Mariner 9 mapped massive extinct volcanoes. It discovered a canyon system spanning 2,500 miles. Smart reprogramming turned a blinded mission into history.
